English: Evidence from observational studies suggests that chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is associated with extrahepatic cancers.

Zulu: Ubufakazi obuvela ezifundweni zokuqaphela buphakamisa ukuthi ukutheleleka ngegciwane le-hepatitis B (HBV) elingapheli lihlotshaniswa nomdlavuza we-extrahepatic.
Hausa: Shaidu daga nazari na lura sun nuna cewa kamuwa da ciwon hanta na B mai tsanani (HBV) yana da alaƙa da cututtukan daji na wajen hanta.

English: We performed two-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) to investigate whether chronic HBV infection is causally associated with extrahepatic cancers.
Luganda: Twakola okulondoba kwa Mendelian okwa sampolo ebbiri ne tunoonyereza oba ng’akawuka ka MR ow’olukonvuba kalina akakwate ak’obuleetezi ne kookolo w’akalulwe.

Zulu: Senze amasampula amabili we-Mendelian randomization (MR) ukuze siphenye ukuthi ukutheleleka kwe-HBV okungapheli kuhlobene yini nomdlavuza we-extrahepatic.
Hausa: Mun yi samfurin bazuwar Mendelian (MR) guda biyu domin bincika ko kamuwa da cutar HBV mai tsanani yana da alaƙa da cututtukan daji na wajen hanta.
Northern Sotho: Mekgwa Re hlaotše disampole tše pedi tša Mendel (MR) ka go se kgetholle go nyakišiša ge e ba phetetšo ya HBV ya go se alafege e bonwa bjalo ka yeo e bakago dikankere tša ka ntle ga sebete.

English: We identified four independent genetic variants strongly associated (P-value < 5 × 10−8) with the exposure, chronic HBV infection in 1371 cases and 2938 controls of East Asian ancestry in Korea, which were used as instrumental variables.
Luganda: Twazuula ebika by’endagabutonde bina ebyetongodde ebyekuusa ennyo (P-value < 5 × 10−8) ku kubeera ne HBV ow’olukonvuba mu bantu 1371 n’abageraageranyizibwako 2938 ab’omu Buvanjuba bwa Asia mu Korea, nga be baakozesebwa ng’ensonga ezeekenneenyezebwa.
Yoruba: A tọká sí irúfẹ̀ ẹ̀yọ́-ìran mẹ́rin tí wọ́n níi ṣe gan-an (P-value < 5 × 10−8) pẹ̀lú ìfaragbá, ìkóràn HBV ọlọ́jọ́ pípẹ́ nínú ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ 1371 àti 2938 fún ìṣàkóso Ìlà-oòrùn Éṣíà tí ó jẹ́ ìbílẹ̀ Korea, èyí tí wọ́n lò gẹ́gẹ́ irinsẹ́ ìdiwọ̀n ìẃdìí.
Zulu: Sihlonze ukuhlukahluka kofuzo okune okuzimele okuhlotshaniswa kakhulu (inani le-P <5 × 10−8) nokuchayeka, ukutheleleka kwe-HBV okungapheli ezimweni ezingu-1371 kanye nokulawula okungu-2938 kokhokho base-East Asia e-Korea, okusetshenziswe njengezinto eziguquguqukayo.
Hausa: Mun gano bambance-bambancen ƙwayoyin gados masu zaman kansu guda huɗu masu ƙarfi da suke da alaƙa (P-value < 5 × 10−8) tare da kamuwa, kamuwa da cutar HBV mai tsanani a cikin kamuwa guda 1371 da kuma shawo kan guda 2938 na zuriyar gabashin Asiya a Koriya, waɗanda aka yi amfani da su a zaman masu canjin kayan aiki.
Northern Sotho: Re lemogile mehuta ye mene ya ditlhamegotšini ye e fapafapanego ya go ikema yeo e amanago thwii (P-value < 5 × 10−8) le tebano, phetetšo ya HBV ya go se alafege go malwetši a 1371 le ditaolo tše 2938 tša lešika la Bohlabela bja Asia go la Korea, tšeo di šomišitšwego bjalo ka pharologantšho tše bohlokwa.
Amharic: ሥር የሰደደ የኤችቢቪ ኢንፌክሽን በ1371 ኬዞች እና ከምስራቅ እስያ የዘር ግንድ በኮሪያ ውስጥ 2938 ቁጥጥሮች፣ እንደ ተለዋዋጮች መሳሪያነት ያገለገሉ፣ ከተጋላጭነት ጋር በደንብ የተያያዙ (P-value <5 × 10-8) አራት ነጻ የሆኑ የዘረመል ልዩነቶችን ለይተናል።

English: Using the multivariable inverse variance weighted method, we found genetic liability to chronic HBV infection causally associated with extrahepatic cancers including cervical cancer (odds ratio [OR] = 1.57, 95% confidence interval [CI] = 1.29–1.91, P-value = 0.0001) and gastric cancer (OR = 1.12, 95% CI = 1.05–1.19, P-value = 0.0001).
Luganda: Nga tukozesa enkola ya multivariable inverse variance weighted method, twazuula ng’okuba n’obulagabutonde bwa HBV ow’olukonvuba kikwanyizibwa mu ngeri y’obuleetezi ne kookolo w’akalulwe omuli kookolo w’omumwa gwa nnabaana (odds ratio [OR] = 1.57, 95% confidence interval [CI] = 1.29–1.91, P-value = 0.0001) ne kookolo w’omu lubuto (OR = 1.12, 95% CI = 1.05–1.19, P-value = 0.0001).
Yoruba: Àwọn ìwádìí tí ó tipa lílo ìwọ̀n iye ìwúwo, a rí i pé ẹ̀rù ajẹ́mọ́jíìnì sí ìkóràn HBV ọlọ́jọpípẹ́ tí ó fara pẹ́ jẹjẹrẹ àpò òróǹro tí ó fi mọ́ jẹjẹrẹ àbáwọlé ọmọ (ìṣòdiwọ̀n òdì [[OR] = 1.57, 95% confidence interval [CI] = 1.29–1.91, P-value = 0.0001) and gastric cancer (OR = 1.12, 95% CI = 1.05–1.19, P-value = 0.0001).
Zulu: Ukuthola Ngokusebenzisa indlela enesisindo eguquguqukayo eguquguqukayo yokuhlukahluka, sithole isibopho sofuzo ekuthelelekeni okungamahlalakhona kwe-HBV okuhlotshaniswa nomdlavuza we-extrahepatic ohlanganisa umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho (isilinganiso sokungezwani [[OR] = 1.57, 95% isikhawu sokuzethemba [CI] = 1.29-1.91, P-value = 0.0001) nomdlavuza wesisu (NOMA = 1.12, 95% CI = 1.05-1.19, P-value = 0.0001).
Hausa: Ta yin amfani da hanyar ma’aunin bambance-bambance daban-daban, mun gano alhaki na ƙwayoyin gado ga kamuwa da cutar HBV nmai tsanani wadda take da alaƙa da cututtukan daji na wajen hanta ciki har da kansar mahaifa (odds ratio [[OR] = 1.57, 95% tazarar tabbaci [CI] = 1.29–1.91, P-value = 0.0001) da kuma kansar ciki (OR = 1.12, 95% CI = 1.05–1.19, P-value = 0.0001).
Northern Sotho: Dikutollo Ka go mokgwa wo o tšeago lehlakore wo o fetogilego wa dipharologantšho tše ntši, re hweditše boikarabelo bja ditlhamegotšini go phetetšo ya HBV ya go se alafege ye e bonwago bjalo ka yeo e bakago dikankere tša ka ntle ga sebete go akaretša kankere ya molomo wa popelo (ratio ya odds [OR] = 1.57, sebaka sa boitshepho ya 95% [CI] = 1.29–1.91, P-value = 0.0001) le kankere ya mogodu (OR = 1.12, 95% CI = 1.05–1.19, P-value = 0.0001).
Amharic: የሁለገብ ተገላቢጦሽ የክብደት ዘዴን በመጠቀም፣ ለሥር ሰደድ የኤችቢቪ ኢንፌክሽን የማህፀን በር ካንሰርን ጨምሮ ከጉበት ውጪ የሚመነጩ ወይም ያሉ ካንሰሮች ጋር በምክንያትነት የተያያዘ የዘረመል ተጠያቂነትን አግኝተናል (የዕድሎች ምጥጥን [OR] = 1.57፣ 95% አስተማማኝ ክፍተት[CI] = 1.29–1.91፣ P-value = 0.0001) እና የጨጓራ ​​ካንሰር (OR = 1.12፣ 95% CI = 1.05-1.19፣ P-value = 0.0001)።

English: Moreover, chronic HBV infection (OR = 1.20, 95% CI = 1.07–1.34, P-value = 0.0021) was causally associated with hepatocellular carcinoma, supporting a well-established association between chronic HBV infection and hepatocellular carcinoma.
Luganda: Ekirala, HBV ow’olukonvuba (OR = 1.20, 95% CI = 1.07–1.34, P-value = 0.0021) yali akwanyizibwa mu ngeri y’obuleetezi hepatocellular carcinoma, nga kino kiwagira akakwate akaakakasibwa edda wakati wa HBV ow’olukonvuba ne hepatocellular carcinoma.
Yoruba: Síwájú síi, ìkóràn HBV ọlọ́jọ́ pípẹ́ (OR = 1.20, 95% CI = 1.07–1.34, P-value = 0.0021) níiṣe pẹ̀lú jẹjẹrẹ ẹ̀dọ̀, tí ó fara mọ́ àjọṣe tí ó fẹsẹ̀ múlẹ̀ láàrin ìkóràn HBV ọlọ́jọ́ pípẹ́ àti jẹjẹrẹ ẹ̀dọ̀.
Zulu: Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukutheleleka okungapheli kwe-HBV (NOMA = 1.20, 95% CI = 1.07-1.34, P-value = 0.0021) kwakuhlobene ne-hepatocellular carcinoma, esekela ubudlelwane obusungulwe kahle phakathi kokutheleleka kwe-HBV okungapheli kanye ne-hepatocellular carcinoma.
Hausa: Bugu da ƙari, an danganta kamuwa da cutar HBV mai tsanani (OR = 1.20, 95% CI = 1.07-1.34, P-value = 0.0021) an da ciwon daji na hanta, yana goyan bayan wata alaƙa mai kyau tsakanin ciwon HBV mai tsanani da kuma ciwon daji na hanta.
Northern Sotho: Go feta moo, phetetšo ya HBV ya go se alafege (OR = 1.20, 95% CI = 1.07–1.34, P-value = 0.0021) e be e bonwa bjalo ka yeo e bakago kankere ya sebete, e thekga kamantšho ye e bonalago gabotse magareng ga phetetšo ya HBV ya go se alafege le kankere ya sebete.
Amharic: ከዚህም በላይ፣ ሥር የሰደደ የኤችቢቪ ኢንፌክሽን (OR = 1.20፣ 95% CI = 1.07-1.34፣ P-value = 0.0021) ከሄፕቶሴሉላር ካርስኖማ ጋር የተቆራኘ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ሥር በሰደደ የኤችቢቪ ኢንፌክሽን እና በሄፕቶሴሉላር ካርስኖማ መካከል ያለውን በደምብ የተቋቋመ ግንኙነትን ይደግፋል።

English: Researchers from South Africa, Uganda, the UK and Taiwan said prolonged Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection can cause several cancer types that occur outside the liver.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza okuva mu South Africa, Uganda, UK ne Taiwan baagamba nti Hepatitis B (HBV) ow’olukonvuba asobola okuleeta ebika bya kookolo eby’enjawulo ebibeera wabweru w’ekibumba.

Zulu: Abacwaningi baseNingizimu Afrika, e-Uganda, e-UK naseTaiwan bathi ukutheleleka ngegciwane le-Hepatitis B (HBV) isikhathi eside kungabangela izinhlobo eziningi zomdlavuza ezenzeka ngaphandle kwesibindi.

Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši go tšwa ka Afrika Borwa, Uganda, UK le Taiwan ba boletše gore phetetšo ya baerase ya Hephathaithisi B (HBV) ye e prolonged e ka baka mehuta ye mmalwa ya kankere yeo e hlagago ka ntle ga sebete.
Amharic: ከደቡብ አፍሪካ፣ ከኡጋንዳ፣ ከእንግሊዝ እና ከታይዋን የተውጣጡ ተመራማሪዎች ለረጅም ጊዜ የሚቆይ የሄፐታይተስ ቢ ቫይረስ (ኤችቢቪ) ኢንፌክሽን ከጉበት ውጭ የሚከሰቱ በርካታ የካንሰር አይነቶችን እንደሚያመጣ ተናግረዋል።

English: This knowledge encourages doctors to test HBV infected patients for various cancers and to manage the disease better.

Yoruba: Ìmọ̀ yìí máa ń gba àwọn dókítà ní ìyànjú láti ṣe àyẹ̀wò àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ní ìkóràn HBV fún onírúnrú jẹjẹrẹ àti láti túbọ̀ ṣàkóso àrùn náà dáadáa.
Zulu: Lolu lwazi lukhuthaza odokotela ukuthi bahlole iziguli ezine-HBV zomdlavuza ohlukahlukene futhi basilawule kangcono lesi sifo.
Hausa: Wannan ilimin yana ƙarfafa gwiwar likitoci domin su gwada masu cutar HBV domin ciwon daji daban-daban da kuma kula da cutar da kyau.
Northern Sotho: Tsebo ye e hlohleletša dingaka go dira diteko tša balwetši bao ba fetetšwego ke HBV go dikankere tša go fapafapana le go laola bolwetši bokaone.

English: Doctors know that a microorganism called Hepatitis B virus (HBV) can cause liver cancer.
Luganda: Abasawo bakimanyi nti akawuka akayitibwa Hepatitis B virus (HBV) kasobola okuleeta kookolo w’ekibumba.
Yoruba: Àwọn dókítà mọ̀ pé àwọn ẹ̀dá àìfojúrí tí wọ́n ń pè ní Kòkòrò àrun jẹ̀dọ̀jẹ̀dọ̀ b (HBV) lè ṣokùnfa jẹjẹrẹ ẹ̀dọ̀.
Zulu: Odokotela bayazi ukuthi i-microorganism ebizwa ngokuthi i-Hepatitis B virus (HBV) ingabangela umdlavuza wesibindi.

Northern Sotho: Dingaka di a tseba gore sephedinyana se se bitšwago baerase ya Hephathaithisi B (HBV) e ka baka kankere ya sebete.
Amharic: ሄፓታይተስ ቢ ቫይረስ (ኤችቢቪ) የተባለ ረቂቅ ተሕዋስ የጉበት ካንሰርን እንደሚያመጣ ዶክተሮቹ ያውቃሉ።

English: They have also observed that it is common for people who have been infected by HBV for a long time, to also suffer from many other cancers.
Luganda: Era baakizuula nti kya bulijjo abantu ababadde ne HBV okumala ekiseera ekiwanvu era okubeera n’ebika bya kookolo eby’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sì tún ti ṣàkíyèsí pé ó wọ́ pọ̀ láàrin àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n ti ní ìkóràn HBV fún ìgbà pípẹ́, láti fara gbá ọ̀pọ̀ àrun jẹjẹrẹ mìíràn.
Zulu: Baphinde baphawula ukuthi kuvamile ukuba abantu asebene-HBV isikhathi eside, baphathwe neminye imidlavuza eminingi.

Northern Sotho: Ba lemogile le gore ke tlwaelo gore batho bao ba bego ba fetetšwe ke HBV nako ye telele, le bona ba ka swarwa ke dikankere tše dingwe tše ntši.

English: In this study, the researchers investigated whether prolonged HBV infection caused these other cancers outside the liver.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baanoonyereza oba ng’okubeera ne HBV okumala ekiseera ekiwanvu kye kyaviirako kookolo omulala ebweru w’ekibumba.

Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi baphenye ukuthi ukutheleleka nge-HBV isikhathi eside kwabangela yini lawa amanye ama-cancer angaphandle kwesibindi.
Hausa: A wannan binciken, masu binciken sun binciki ko kamuwa da cutar HBV na tsawon lokaci ya haifar da wasu cututtukan daji a wajen hanta.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba nyakišišitše ge e ba phetetšo ye e tšerego nako ya HBV e hlotše dikankere tše tše dingwe ka ntle ga sebete.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ የረጅም ጊዜ የኤችቢቪ ኢንፌክሽን እነዚህን ሌሎች ካንሰሮችን ከጉበት ውጭ ያመጣ እንደሆነ መርምረዋል።

Yoruba: Wọ́n wádìí ohun ìṣàyẹ̀wò àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ti gbà tẹ́lẹ̀ ní àwọn ilé-ìwòsàn jákèjádò Japan.
Zulu: Bafunde amasampula esiguli ayeqoqwe ezibhedlela kulo lonke elaseJapan.

Northern Sotho: Ba ithutile disampole tša balwetši tša peleng tše di kgobokeditšwego go dipetlele nageng ya Japane ka bophara.

English: The researchers used genetic information to predict whether HBV infection could also cause cancers outside the liver, for example, in the cervix, bile duct (the tube that connects the liver to the small intestine), lungs, throat or intestines.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakozesa obubaka bw’endagabutonde okuteebereza oba ng’okubeera ne HBV era kisobola okuleeta kookolo wabweru w’ekibumba, okugeza, mu mumwa gwa nnabaana, akalulwe (akaseke agagatta ekibumba ku kyenda ekitono), amawuggwe, omumiro oba ebyenda.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà lo ̀làyé nípa ẹ̀yọ́-ìran láti fi se àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ bóyá HBV náà lè ṣokùnfà jẹjẹrẹ ní àyíká ẹ̀dọ̀, bí àpẹẹrẹ, nínú àbáwọlé ilé ọmọ, àpò òróǹro (túùrù tí ó so ẹ̀dọ̀ mọ́ abonú), ẹ̀dọ̀fóró, ọ̀fun tàbí ìfun.
Zulu: Abacwaningi basebenzisa ulwazi lofuzo ukuze babikezele ukuthi ukutheleleka kwe-HBV kungase futhi kubangele umdlavuza ngaphandle kwesibindi, isibonelo, emlonyeni wesibeletho, i-bile duct (ishubhu elixhuma isibindi emathunjini amancane), amaphaphu, umphimbo noma amathumbu.

Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba šomišitše tshedimošo ya ditlhamegotšini go akanya ge e ba phetetšo ya HBV le yona e ka hlola dikankere tša ka ntle ga sebete, mohlala, ka gare ga molomo wa popelo, karolo  ya bohloko (lela le le kgokaganyago sebete le mala a mannyane), maswafo, mometšo goba ka maleng.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የኤችቢቪ ኢንፌክሽን ከጉበት ውጪ ያሉ ካንሰሮችን ለምሳሌ በማህፀን በር ጫፍ፣ በሃሞት ቱቦ (ጉበትን ከትንሹ አንጀት ጋር የሚያገናኘው ቱቦ)፣ ሳንባ፣ ጉሮሮ ወይም አንጀቶች ውስጥ ያሉ ካንሰሮችን ሊያመጣ ይችል እንደሆን ለመገመት የዘረመል መረጃን ተጠቅመዋል።

English: Their results confirmed that prolonged HBV infection caused liver cancer, as well as other cancers outside the liver, such as cervical or stomach cancers.
Luganda: Bye baazuula byakakasa nti HBV ow’olukonvuba aleeta kookolo w’ekibumba, awamu n’ebika bya kookolo ebirala wabweru w’ekibumba, okugeza kookolo w’omumwa gwa nnabaana n’ow’omu lubuto.

Zulu: Imiphumela yabo yaqinisekisa ukuthi ukutheleleka nge-HBV isikhathi eside kwabangela umdlavuza wesibindi, kanye neminye imidlavuza engaphandle kwesibindi, njengomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho noma wesisu.

Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tša bona di tiišeditše gore phetetšo ya HBV ye e tšerego nako e bakile kankere ya sebete, gammogo le dikankere tše dingwe ka ntle ga sebete, tše bjalo ka dikankere tša molomo wa popelo le tša ka maleng.

English: People with HBV infection were also more likely to suffer from cancers of the bile duct, womb (uterus), colon, rectum, throat and pancreas.
Luganda: Abantu abalina HBV era baali basuubirwa nnyo okufuna kookolo w’akalulwe, nnabaana, ebyenda, omumiro n’akataago.
Yoruba: Ó ṣeé ṣe kí àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n ní HBV tún fara gbá àwọn àìsàn jẹjẹrẹ àpò òróǹro, abọ́dìí, káà fùrọ̀, ọ̀fun àti àmọ́.
Zulu: Abantu abane-HBV basengozini enkulu yokuphathwa umdlavuza we-bile duct, isibeletho (isibeletho), ikholoni, i-rectum, umphimbo kanye ne-pancreas.
Hausa: Mutanen da suke ɗauke da cutar HBV su ma sun fi fama da ciwon daji na bututun ruwan maɗaciya da mahaifa (mahaifa) da uwar hanji da dubura da maƙogwaro da kuma saifa.
Northern Sotho: Batho bao ba nago le phetetšo ya HBV le bona go be go na le kgonagalo ya gore ba ka swarwa ke dikankere tša karolo ya bohloko, ka mpeng (popelo), lelakgolo, motsila, mogolo le pankarea.
Amharic: የኤችቢቪ ቫይረስ ያለባቸው ሰዎች በሃሞት ቱቦ፣ ማህፀን (ማህፀን)፣ ደንዳኔ፣ ፊንጢጣ፣ ጉሮሮ እና ቆሽት ካንሰሮች የመጠቃት እድላቸው ከፍተኛ ነው።

English: They however found that people with HBV infections had reduced chances of ovarian cancer.
Luganda: Wabula baakizuula nti abantu abalina HBV baalina emikisa mitono egy’okufuna kookolo w’ensawo y’amagi.
Yoruba: Àmọ́ wọ́n padà ríi pé àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n ní ìkóràn HBV ti dín ààyè láti ní jẹjẹrẹ ibú ẹyin.
Zulu: Nokho bathole ukuthi abantu abane-HBV bawanciphise amathuba okuba nomdlavuza wesibeletho.
Hausa: Duk da haka sun gano cewa mutanen da suke da cututtukan HBV sun rage yiwuwar ciwon daji na mafitar ƙwan mace.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, ba hweditše gore batho bao ba nago le diphetetšo tša HBV ba bile le dibaka tše di fokotšegilego tša go ba le kankere ya popelo.
Amharic: ይሁን እንጂ የኤችቢቪ ኢንፌክሽን ያለባቸው ሰዎች በማህፀን ካንሰር የመያዝ እድላቸው እንደቀነሰ ደርሰውበታል።

English: Ovarian cancer affects the ovaries, and therefore fertility, as they are part of the female sex organs that release eggs.
Luganda: Kookolo w’ensawo y’amagi akosa ensawo z’amagi, era bw’atyo n’alemesa okuzaala, olw’okuba nga ziri kimu ku bitundu by’omukazi ebizaazi ezifulumya amagi.
Yoruba: Jẹjẹrẹ ibú ẹyin a máa nípa lórí ibú ẹyin, nípa bẹ́ẹ̀ ní ipa lórí ìbí, gẹ́gẹ́ bí ó ti jẹ́ pé wọ́n wà lára àwọn ẹ̀yà-àra ìbí obìnrin tí wọ́n ń pèsè àwọn ẹyin.
Zulu: Umdlavuza we-ovarian uthinta ama-ovari, ngakho-ke ukuzala, njengoba beyingxenye yezitho zobulili zesifazane ezikhulula amaqanda.
Hausa: Ciwon daji na mafitar ƙwan maace yana shafar ƙwai, don haka haihuwa, saboda suna cikin sassan jikin mace masu sakin ƙwai.
Northern Sotho: Kankere ya dišegomae e ama dipopelo, gwa latela bokgoni bja monontšho, ka ge e le karolo ya ditho tša thobalano tša basadi tšeo di lokollago mae.
Amharic: የማህፀን ካንሰር እንቁላሎችን የሚለቁት የሴት የጾታ አካላት ከፍል በመሆናቸው፣ እንቁልጢዎችን፣ እና ስለዚህ መራባትን ይጎዳል።

English: They said they found 4 genetic variations that were more likely to favour HBV infection in people originating from East Asia.
Luganda: Baagamba nti baazuula obulagabutonde bwa bika 4 obwali bulabika nga bwettanira nnyo abantu abalina HBV mu bantu abava mu Buvanjuba bwa Asia.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé àwọn rí ẹ̀yà ajẹmọ́ ẹ̀yọ́-ìran 4 tí ó ṣeé ṣe kí wọ́n ṣègbè ìkóràn HBV lára àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n ń ti Ìlà-oòrùn Éṣíà wá.
Zulu: Bathe bathole ukuhlukahluka kofuzo oku-4 okungenzeka ukuthi kuthande ukutheleleka kwe-HBV kubantu abavela e-East Asia.
Hausa: Sun ce sun gano bambance-bambancen ƙwayoyin gado guda 4 da suka fi dacewa da kamuwa da cutar HBV a cikin mutanen da suka samo asali daga Gabashin Asiya.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore ba hweditše dipharologantšho tša ditlhamegotšini tše 4 tšeo go bego go na le kgonagalo ya gore di ka thekga phetetšo ya HBV go batho bao ka tlhago ba tšwago Bohlabela bja Asia.
Amharic: ከምስራቅ እስያ በመጡ ሰዎች ላይ የኤችቢቪ ኢንፌክሽንን የበለጠ የሚደግፉ 4 የዘረመል ልዩነቶች እንዳገኙ ተናግረዋል።

English: The researchers said they did not find much difference between Korean and Japanese patients in their results.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti tebaasanga njawulo ya maanyi wakati w’abalwadde b’e Korea ne Japan mu bye baazuula.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé àwọn kò rí ìyàtọ̀ tí ó pọ̀ láàrin èsì àyẹ̀wò àwọn aláìsàn ilè Korea ati Japan.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi abatholanga mehluko omkhulu phakathi kweziguli zaseKorea nezaseJapan emiphumeleni yazo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce ba su sami bambanci sosai a tsakanin majinyatan Koriya da kuma Japan ba a sakamakonsu.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore ga se ba hwetša phapano ye ntši magareng ga balwetši ba Korea le Japane ka dipoelong tša bona.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በውጤታቸው ላይ በኮሪያ እና በጃፓን ታካሚዎች መካከል ብዙ ልዩነት እንዳላገኙ ተናግረዋል።

English: This was the first study to show that HBV infection could cause other cancers other than liver cancer.
Luganda: Kuno kwe kwali okunoonyereza okusooka okulaga nti obulwadde bwa HBV busobola okuleeta kookolo ow’ebika ebirala ng’oggyeeko kookolo w’e kibumba.
Yoruba: Èyí ni ìwádìí àkọ́kọ́ tí ó fi hàn pé ìkóràn HBV lè ṣokùnfà àwọn ẹ̀yà jẹjẹrẹ mìíràn yàtọ̀ sí ẹ̀dọ̀.
Zulu: Lolu bekuwucwaningo lokuqala olukhombisa ukuthi ukutheleleka nge-HBV kungadala eminye imidlavuza ngaphandle komdlavuza wesibindi.
Hausa: Wannan shi ne binciken farko da ya nuna cewa kamuwa da cutar HBV yana iya haifar da wasu cututtukan daji fiye da na hanta.
Northern Sotho: Tše e bile dinyakišišo tša mathomo go bontšha gore phetetšo ya HBV e ka baka dikankere tše dingwe ka ntle ga kankere ya sebete.
Amharic: ይሄ የኤችቢቪ ኢንፌክሽን ከጉበት ካንሰር በስተቀር ሌሎች ካንሰሮችን እንደሚያመጣ የሚያሳየው የመጀመሪያው ጥናት ነው።

English: The researchers however said that their results did not show very strong relationships, and that might have been because of the small number of cases for some cancer types in the samples they studied.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza wabula baagamba nti bye baazuula tebyalaga kakwate ka maanyi, era ekyo kiyinza okubeera nga kyava ku muwendo omutono ogw’abalwadde b’ebika bya kookolo ebimu mu sampolo ze beekaliriza.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà wá sọ pé èsì wọn kò ṣàfihàn ìbáṣepọ̀ tí ó gbópọn, èyí sì lè jẹ́ nítorí iye ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àìsàn tí kò pọ̀ fún àwọn ẹ̀yà jẹjẹrẹ kọ̀ọ̀kan nínú àwọn ohun-àyẹ̀wò tí wọ́n ṣe ìwádìí lé lórí.
Zulu: Abacwaningi nokho bathi imiphumela yabo ayizange ibonise ubudlelwano obuqinile kakhulu, futhi lokho kungenzeka ukuthi kwakungenxa yezibalo ezincane zezinhlobo ezithile zomdlavuza kumasampula abawafundile.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce sakamakon nasu bai nuna dangantaka mai karfi ba, kuma hakan na iya kasancewa saboda karancin adadin wasu nau'in ciwon daji a cikin samfuran da suka yi nazari.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, banyakišiši ba boletše gore dipoelo tša bona ga se tša bontšha dikamano tše maatla kudu, le gore tšeo di ka ba di bakilwe ke palo ye nnyane ya melato go mehuta ye mengwe ya kankere ka disampoleng tšeo ba ithutilego ka tšona.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ግን ውጤቶቻቸው በጣም ጠንካራ ግንኙነቶችን እንዳላሳዩ፣ እና ይህ ሊሆን የቻለው ምናልባት ባጠኗቸው ናሙናዎች ውስጥ ለአንዳንድ የካንሰር ዓይነቶች የሚሆኑ ኬዞች ቁጥር አነስተኛ በመሆኑ ነው ብለዋል።

English: They also said their study only included people from East Asia, and other communities might show different results.
Luganda: Era baagamba nti okunoonyereza kwabwe kwalimu bantu abava mu Buvanjuba bwa Asia bokka, so ng’ebitundu ebirala biyinza okulaga ebivaamu eby’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Wón tún sọ pé ìwádìí àwọn ní àwọn ènìyàn láti apá Ìlà-oòrùn Éṣíà nìkan, àti pé èsì láti àwọn àdúgbò mìíràn lè ṣàfihàn àbájáde tí ó yàtọ̀.
Zulu: Baphinde bathi ucwaningo lwabo luhlanganisa abantu baseMpumalanga Asia kuphela, kanti eminye imiphakathi ingase ibonise imiphumela ehlukile.
Hausa: Sun kuma ce binciken nasu ya haɗa da mutanen Gabashin Asiya ne kawai, kuma sauran al’ummomi suna iya nuna sakamako daban-daban.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše le gore dinyakišišo tša bona di akareditše batho go tšwa Bohlabela bja Asia, gomme ditšhaba tše dingwe di ka laetša dipoelo tše di fapanego.
Amharic: ጥናታቸው ከምስራቅ እስያ የመጡ ሰዎችን ብቻ ያካተተ ሲሆን፣ ሌሎች ማህበረሰቦችም የተለያዩ ውጤቶችን ሊያሳዩ እንደሚችሉ ጨምረው ተናግረዋል።

English: The study was done by researchers based in universities in South Africa, Uganda, the UK and Taiwan.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwakolebwa abanoonyereza okuva mu ziyunivaasite mu South Africa, Uganda, UK ne Taiwan.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwásìí tí wọ́n fi fasìtì ilè South Africa, Uganda, UK àti Taiwan ṣe ibùdó ni wọ́n se ìwádìí náà.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo lwenziwe abacwaningi abazinze emanyuvesi aseNingizimu Afrika, Uganda, UK naseTaiwan.
Hausa: Masu bincike da suke zaune a jami’o’i a Afirka ta Kudu da Yuganda da UK da kuamTaiwan ne suka gudanar da wannan binciken.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di dirilwe ke banyakišiši bao ba lego diyunibesithing tša Afrika Borwa, Uganda, UK le Taiwan.
Amharic: ጥናቱ የተካሄደው በደቡብ አፍሪካ፣ በኡጋንዳ፣ በእንግሊዝ እና በታይዋን ፕየሚገኙ ዩኒቨርሲቲዎች ውስጥ ባሉ ተመራማሪዎች ነው።
